description: 25 benchmark questions for MaternalCare AI Phase 1. Ground truths were drafted from the indexed chunk text (data/processed/processed_chunks.json) and were verified on 2026-11-10 against the cited PDF pages (text extracted independently with pdftotext; LLM-assisted cross-check; see eval/results/benchmark_verification_2026-11-10.md): 25/25 valid, no corrections. No clinician has reviewed them. Gold pages were found by text search in the chunks, not by the retriever, so retrieval metrics are not biased by the system itself. Ground truths are written in English (the language of most sources); Arabic questions keep English ground truths.

queries.question: How many antenatal care contacts does WHO recommend during pregnancy?
queries.ground_truth: WHO recommends antenatal care models with a minimum of eight contacts to reduce perinatal mortality and improve women's experience of care.
queries.verified_by: LLM-assisted source-page cross-check (pdftotext), not a clinician

queries.question: المفروض أروح متابعة حمل كام مرة على الأقل؟
queries.ground_truth: WHO recommends antenatal care models with a minimum of eight contacts to reduce perinatal mortality and improve women's experience of care.
queries.verified_by: LLM-assisted source-page cross-check (pdftotext), not a clinician

queries.question: Which medicine is recommended to prevent eclampsia in women with severe pre-eclampsia?
queries.ground_truth: Magnesium sulfate is recommended for the prevention of eclampsia in women with severe pre-eclampsia, in preference to other anticonvulsants (high-quality evidence, strong recommendation).
queries.verified_by: LLM-assisted source-page cross-check (pdftotext), not a clinician

queries.question: لو ضغطي عالي شوية بس مش جامد وأنا حامل، لازم آخد علاج للضغط؟
queries.ground_truth: Women with non-severe hypertension during pregnancy should be offered antihypertensive drug treatment in the context of good quality antenatal care follow-up; oral methyldopa and beta-blockers should be considered effective treatment options.
queries.verified_by: LLM-assisted source-page cross-check (pdftotext), not a clinician

queries.question: When is calcium supplementation recommended for pregnant women?
queries.ground_truth: In populations with low dietary calcium intake, daily calcium supplementation is recommended for pregnant women to reduce the risk of pre-eclampsia (context-specific recommendation, moderate-certainty evidence).
queries.verified_by: LLM-assisted source-page cross-check (pdftotext), not a clinician

queries.question: What fasting plasma glucose value is used by WHO to diagnose gestational diabetes?
queries.ground_truth: Gestational diabetes is diagnosed if fasting plasma glucose is 5.1-6.9 mmol/l (92-125 mg/dl), or 1-hour glucose is at least 10.0 mmol/l, or 2-hour glucose is 8.5-11.0 mmol/l after a 75 g oral glucose load.
queries.verified_by: LLM-assisted source-page cross-check (pdftotext), not a clinician

queries.question: إمتى المفروض أعمل تحليل سكر الحمل لو عندي عوامل خطورة؟
queries.ground_truth: Women with risk factors for gestational diabetes should be offered a 75-g 2-hour oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) at 24 to 28 weeks; women with previous gestational diabetes are offered early self-monitoring or an OGTT soon after booking.
queries.verified_by: LLM-assisted source-page cross-check (pdftotext), not a clinician

queries.question: Can I take NSAIDs such as ibuprofen after 20 weeks of pregnancy?
queries.ground_truth: FDA recommends avoiding NSAIDs in pregnancy at 20 weeks or later because they can cause rare but serious kidney problems in the unborn baby that lead to low amniotic fluid; use should be decided by a health care professional.
queries.verified_by: LLM-assisted source-page cross-check (pdftotext), not a clinician

queries.question: هل البنادول (الباراسيتامول) بيعمل تشوهات للجنين؟
queries.ground_truth: When used at recommended dosages, acetaminophen (paracetamol) has not been shown to increase the chance of birth defects; about 3 in 100 babies have a birth defect regardless of exposure.
queries.verified_by: LLM-assisted source-page cross-check (pdftotext), not a clinician

queries.question: When should breastfeeding be started after birth?
queries.ground_truth: All mothers should be supported to initiate breastfeeding as soon as possible after birth, within the first hour after delivery.
queries.verified_by: LLM-assisted source-page cross-check (pdftotext), not a clinician

queries.question: إمتى أبدأ أرضّع البيبي بعد الولادة؟

queries.question: How many postnatal care contacts does WHO recommend after birth?
queries.ground_truth: A minimum of four postnatal care contacts is recommended; after a facility birth, healthy women and newborns should receive care in the facility for at least 24 hours.
queries.verified_by: LLM-assisted source-page cross-check (pdftotext), not a clinician

queries.question: Which foods can carry Listeria and should be avoided in pregnancy?
queries.ground_truth: Listeria monocytogenes is found in ready-to-eat refrigerated foods such as deli meats, unpasteurized (raw) milk, and soft cheeses made with unpasteurized milk; it can cause listeriosis and pass to the unborn child.
queries.verified_by: LLM-assisted source-page cross-check (pdftotext), not a clinician

queries.question: إيه أنواع السمك اللي لازم أتجنبها وأنا حامل؟
queries.ground_truth: Fish with the highest mercury levels should be avoided: king mackerel, marlin, orange roughy, shark, swordfish, tilefish (Gulf of Mexico) and bigeye tuna.
queries.verified_by: LLM-assisted source-page cross-check (pdftotext), not a clinician

queries.question: How should the baby's heart rate be monitored during labour for a woman at low risk?
queries.ground_truth: Women with a low risk of complications should be offered fetal heart rate monitoring with intermittent auscultation in the established first stage of labour, using a Pinard stethoscope or doppler ultrasound.
queries.verified_by: LLM-assisted source-page cross-check (pdftotext), not a clinician

queries.question: Which medicine is recommended to prevent postpartum haemorrhage?
queries.ground_truth: All women giving birth should be offered a uterotonic during the third stage of labour to prevent postpartum haemorrhage; oxytocin is the recommended uterotonic of choice, with other injectable uterotonics or misoprostol as alternatives where oxytocin is unavailable.
queries.verified_by: LLM-assisted source-page cross-check (pdftotext), not a clinician

queries.question: يعني إيه نزيف ما بعد الولادة؟ وهو خطير؟
queries.ground_truth: Postpartum haemorrhage is usually defined as blood loss of 500 ml or more within 24 hours after birth; it is the leading cause of maternal deaths worldwide and is largely preventable and treatable.
queries.verified_by: LLM-assisted source-page cross-check (pdftotext), not a clinician

queries.question: هل الحامل محتاجة تاخد حديد وحمض فوليك؟
queries.ground_truth: Daily oral iron and folic acid supplementation is recommended for pregnant women; intermittent (weekly) supplementation is an option when daily iron is not acceptable because of side effects.
queries.verified_by: LLM-assisted source-page cross-check (pdftotext), not a clinician

queries.question: What symptoms can be signs of pre-eclampsia getting worse?
queries.ground_truth: Elevated blood pressure, headache, blurred vision, convulsions or loss of consciousness; pre-eclampsia can progress rapidly to severe pre-eclampsia, and convulsions with signs of pre-eclampsia indicate eclampsia.
queries.verified_by: LLM-assisted source-page cross-check (pdftotext), not a clinician
